description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claims to land parcels of Nikapothagama, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No.  420350
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and encumbrances) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership, property rights, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
